name: First Day
text: Picked a Forgeling out of the e-waste bin. Warranty sticker still on.

name: Reply All
text: Survived your first battle with Kevin. He has already emailed everyone about it.

name: Ticket Closer
text: Resolved 3 help desk tickets. The queue noticed.

name: Have You Tried...
text: Fixed a printer by turning it off and on again. A classic for a reason.

name: Could Not Reproduce
text: Looked into the 3-2-1 rule. Still no idea what it's for.

name: Tested Fridays
text: Found an old backup tape with a label nobody remembers writing.

name: Version 2.0
text: Upgraded a Forgeling to a new version. No restart required.

name: Full Stack
text: Filled all six slots of your Active Stack. Very full-stack.

name: Inventory Audit
text: Quarantined 10 different kinds of Forgeling for the CMDB.

name: Certified
text: Earned your first Certification. Frame it.

name: Double Certified
text: Earned two Certifications. Your email signature is getting long.
